## DRM
### 0.3.1 Change Log
#### Global
##### Added
* Added checkbox filters and sorting for trainer battle records in DRM Admin.
* Added dialogue node search across names, dialogue text, and choice labels.
* Added pinned filters for directly connected dialogue nodes.
* Added a shared registered currency search picker for editors and addons.
* Added runtime previews to the Remnant Message editor.
* Added search and direct selection to installed Remnant Message lists.
##### Fixed
* Fixed DNPC relation actions incorrectly requiring a legacy faction ID when saving quests.
* Fixed deleted shop search fields reappearing after saving, reloading, or opening shops.
* Fixed the Controls category to display Dochi's RPG Maker in every language.
* Fixed Popup Maker values resetting when opening or canceling file and selection dialogs.
* Fixed Scene Maker undo restoring another scene after loading or creating a document.
* Fixed installed Remnant Message searches truncating long JSON filenames.
* Fixed quest drafts disappearing after catalog refreshes, resizing, or description alignment.
* Fixed unrelated quest responses prematurely unlocking pending saves.
* Fixed invalid quest numbers silently reverting to default values.
* Fixed Quest Editor undo history and unsaved status updates.
* Fixed Remnant Message saves overwriting another document during pending or failed loads.
* Fixed Remnant Message drafts, focus, caret positions, and selections resetting on resize.
* Fixed partial text formatting erasing surrounding styles in Dialogue Editor and other text editors.
* Fixed Remnant Message modal input and save acknowledgment handling.
* Fixed invalid marker scale values silently saving previous values.
##### Improved
* Improved item descriptions and usage messages for current tools, permissions, and NPC integrations.
* Improved Quest Editor validation errors and recovery after Save As conflicts.
* Improved Remnant Message layouts, localized controls, and visible formatting states.
#### Forge 1.20.1
##### Added
* Added Scene Maker with camera paths, subtitles, audio, timeline editing, and server-side playback.
##### Fixed
* Fixed crashes when clicking controls in the Remnant Message marker setup screen.
* Fixed timeline pastes failing instead of extending the scene duration.
* Fixed scene save replies marking newer, unsaved edits as saved.
* Fixed authored multiline quest titles being cleared when committing editor fields.
* Fixed crashes when opening or clicking Remnant Message world lists.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Added
* Added temporary movement permissions for external NPC control.
##### Fixed
* Fixed GeckoLib models being disabled without CustomNPCs.
* Fixed missing-CustomNPCs crashes during model previews, asset reloads, and periodic cleanup.
#### Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Added
* Added optional native appearance snapshots to the public NPC actor API.
* Added optional DRM Admin sections with shared permissions, offline queues, and audit records.
* Added addon-owned target pickers to dialogue action editing.
* Added shared visual timelines and viewports for addon presentation effects.
* Added scoped GUI bindings, component input handlers, and registered inspector pickers.
* Added decoded texture pixel access for alpha-aware sprite effects.
* Added resource reload recovery for addon texture consumers.
* Added addon-defined condition operators and value-field settings in shared editors.
* Added registered addon target pickers across shared condition editors.
* Added validation that rejects invalid addon configurations before saving.
* Added addon dialogue callbacks distinguishing completion, cancellation, ESC dismissal, and unavailable choices.
##### Fixed
* Fixed entity previews disappearing or cropping models at scaled editor sizes.
* Fixed registered GUI components losing authored sprite fill, scale, and tile ratios.
* Fixed addon button previews ignoring vanilla settings and leaving custom colors editable.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1 / NeoForge 26.3
##### Added
* Added multiple attribute effect editing in Stat Builder.
* Added live stat cost and effect calculation previews.
* Added multiline stat descriptions.
##### Fixed
* Fixed failed Quest Editor Save As requests changing the original pack.
* Fixed copied quests retaining internal references to the original pack.
* Fixed stat investment costs consuming XP points instead of displayed experience levels.
* Fixed Stat Builder copies sharing the original set identity.
* Fixed stat drafts losing input after resizing or delayed resource responses.
* Fixed invalid stat numbers silently changing during saving.
* Fixed delayed currency selections editing a different stat.
* Fixed stat defaults resetting when resource replies arrive during Save As.
* Fixed saved-state labels changing when switching selected stats or effects.
##### Improved
* Improved stat allocation layouts, small-screen readability, and unavailable-action feedback.
* Improved default stat names and descriptions with localization.
* Improved consistency between GUI Maker previews and actual stat screens.
#### Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 26.3
##### Fixed
* Fixed quest condition panels crowding description fields in narrow editor layouts.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1 / NeoForge 26.3
##### Fixed
* Fixed new item definitions sharing filenames when names cannot form IDs.
* Fixed item drafts losing text and focus after catalog refreshes or resizing.
* Fixed delayed item save responses redirecting saves to a previous document.
* Fixed incomplete scaling rules disappearing while selecting their stat and attribute.
* Fixed canceled item pickers reopening after delayed catalog responses.
* Fixed item-set links using filenames instead of definition IDs.
* Fixed linked item-set editors hiding bonus and attribute rows.
* Fixed invalid item numbers and incomplete rules being silently changed during saving.
##### Changed
* Changed stat set selection to retain existing item rules.
##### Improved
* Improved item rule editing with multiple rows, checked deletion, and draggable scrolling.
* Improved item previews, saved-state labels, template selection, and localized controls.
* Improved test-item requests with saved-draft checks and server-confirmed feedback.
#### Fabric 1.21.1 / Fabric 26.3
##### Fixed
* Fixed missing item models for legacy database equipment and consumables on Fabric.
* Fixed excluded Item Editor test actions remaining registered on Fabric.
#### NeoForge 26.3
##### Fixed
* Fixed default Vitality effects and preserved legacy maximum-health attribute definitions.
#### Fabric & NeoForge 26.3
##### Fixed
* Fixed DRM Admin refreshes overwriting cached legacy faction data.
* Fixed crashes when rendering native shop buttons.
##### Changed
* Changed NPC basic editing to use registered native actor providers.
* Changed quest imports to use available registered import providers.
* Changed new relation actions to use DNPC groups on Minecraft 26.3.
* Changed Minecraft 26.3 integrations to permanently exclude CustomNPCs runtime adapters.
